images.label: A04
images.observations: Narrow fragment with damaged grooves; no complete diagnostic G01–G06 complex established. Modern ink on second view excluded.

images.label: A05
images.observations: Compartmented upper view; pointed contour at left is a coarse candidate, but broken join and internal details prevent strict identity. Upright strokes at right do not securely show one rightward branch.

images.label: A06
images.observations: Multi-view composite with compartments, repeated round outlines with near-vertical interior bars, angular complexes and separate deep depressions. Round outlines are not strict G03 because bar orientation differs; uncertain allograph relation. Repeated signs within views must not be counted as different objects.

images.label: A07
images.observations: Cell-like partition, separate deep depressions, short parallel grooves, and an upright double-branch construction at lower left. Double branch is not merged with one-branch G02. Pointed frame in central region is coarse G01 candidate.

images.label: A08
images.observations: Two large pointed rightward contours in separate compartments, with internal detail; coarse G01 similarity. Right field has separate short grooves. Exact identity to pilot not established.

images.label: A09
images.observations: Damaged compartmented fragment with an incomplete rounded contour in lower central area. Missing outline/interior means no strict G03 match.

images.label: A10
images.observations: Pointed contour near upper centre with uncertain interior; another in lower view, possible same object different face. Coarse G01 candidate, no strict identity.

images.label: A11
images.observations: Clear grid-like layout, deep depressions beside bundles of short parallel grooves and complex framed/angular marks. Parallel bundles vary in visible multiplicity. Rounded and rectangular frames must be kept distinct. Lower view appears damaged, no confident cross-view sign pairing.
